topic: Grupo L’Oréal anuncia vencedores da 2ª edição do Dermatologia + Inclusiva em cerimônia na UFF Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: Grupo L'Oréal announced the winners of the 2nd edition of the Dermatologia + Inclusiva award, focusing on diversity in dermatology.
Four projects were awarded, emphasizing research on skin and hair of Black, Indigenous, and transgender individuals.
The winners will be announced in early 2026, highlighting the ongoing commitment to inclusivity in dermatological research.

quotes.text: Pioneiro no Brasil, o prêmio é considerado uma iniciativa inédita voltada à diversidade na dermatologia.

summary: Grupo L'Oréal has recognized four innovative projects in the 2nd edition of the Dermatologia + Inclusiva award, aimed at enhancing diversity in dermatological research. The initiative underscores the importance of inclusivity for marginalized communities, with winners set to be revealed in 2026.
